title: Create: Renewable Platinum
description: Create: Renewable Platinum adds Albium to make Platinum renewable in Create Simulated: Propulsion
body:
# Create: Renewable Platinum
## Albium
**Albium** is a new addition to the _Create_ family of Ochrum, Crimsite, Asurine, and Veridium! It generates underground like the others and is renewable through _Create Mechanical Extruder's_ Extruder. Like the others, Albium is used to make a Crushed Raw ore, this time being _Create Propulsion: Simulated's_ Platinum.
## Dependencies
_Create: Renewable Platinum_ requires the following mods to function:
- _Create_
- _Create Mechanical Extruder_
- _Create Propulsion: Simulated_
  - _Create Aeronautics_
 ## Supported Loaders
_Create: Renewable Platinum_ supports Neoforge 1.21.1
